title.rendered: Manchester United Kits 2025 – 26 For Dream League Soccer 2026

content.rendered:
Manchester United kit for season 2025 – 2026 and logo (Man U.) which can be imported by copying the DLS kits URLs below and pasting any of your preferred kit URL into any latest Dream League Soccer or older versions. The kits can also be imported into any FTS Android game also.

This kit helps you to customize your Dream League Soccer Team the way you want your players to appear on the football pitch.

Manchester United Home Kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/pZmhrow.png

Manchester United Away Kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/lduBr57.png

Manchester United Third DLS Kit 

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/SCYhBDZ.png

Manchester United Goal Keeper kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/5qKC5xV.png

Goal Keeper Away DLS Kit Manchester United

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/MD0a64C.png

Manchester United Team Logo For DLS

Copy Logo URL: https://ristechy.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/Manchester-United-DLS-Logo.png
